title: Bashar - The 5 Universal Laws (Darryl Anka)
author: Love Is The Way
opening_summary: Bashar describes the five universal laws that form the foundation of existence. Law one: you exist and cannot change that fact. Law two: everything is here and now; space and time are illusions separated by frequency. Law three: the one is the all—everything is made from one substance. Law four: what you put out returns to you, but more accurately, you naturally attract what you need and must stop blocking it with fear-based beliefs. Law five: everything changes except the laws themselves. The speaker emphasizes that consciousness shifts through billions of parallel realities each second, creating the illusion of continuous time and movement.

qa_topics.question: What are the five universal laws?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Existence, simultaneity, oneness, reciprocal vibration, and universal change form the structural framework of reality that never alters.

qa_topics.question: How does the law of attraction actually work?
qa_topics.answer_gist: You already vibrate at your natural frequency to attract what you need; blocking occurs through fear and negative beliefs rather than lack of attraction.

qa_topics.question: What are parallel realities and timelines?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Parallel realities are frozen snapshots; timelines are series of these frames viewed through continuity, created by consciousness shifting through billions of realities per second.

qa_topics.question: Can changing your present change your past?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Yes, shifting your present identity requires a different past history to have created that new person, altering your personal timeline retroactively.

qa_topics.question: What is the Mandela Effect?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Different people remember different pasts because they exist on different parallel reality tracks yet share a common present, both memories being equally valid.

qa_topics.question: How are realities splitting now?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Glass walls separate vibrationally incompatible realities; people increasingly experience different Earth versions based on their frequency choices.

qa_topics.question: Is our inner world always reflected in outer reality?
qa_topics.answer_gist: Yes, physical reality is a mirror; it can only reflect what you give it, operating without independent mind or choice.

qa_topics.question: How should we measure true change?
qa_topics.answer_gist: True change means maintaining a positive state regardless of circumstances, extracting benefit from all experiences through internal alignment rather than external conditions.

quotes.quote: You can't become non-existent because by definition non-existence doesn't exist.
Physical reality is just a mirror so it can only reflect what you give it.
You're flickering through billions of frames creating the illusion of movement.
When you change your present you're actually changing your past as well.
The box is now leaking and we're starting to get glimpses of parallel realities.
quotes.context: Discussing spiritual awakening and reality breakdown

quotes.quote: True change is being the positive state you prefer regardless of circumstances.

notes: Re-upload/clip channel (Love Is The Way), not official. Core 'Five Laws' teaching plus parallel-reality/timeline mechanics and the Mandela Effect.
